title: 恢复竞争性评测集成分支的绿色 CI 基线

result.issue_update_attempt: GitHub connector returned HTTP 403 for both comment and close; no issue mutation occurred.

root_causes: Tests still asserted a mandatory working_state sentence and total_tokens convenience field after their public contracts changed.
Strategy export reconstructed provider usage instead of reusing the execution owner's measured-usage contract.
OpenAI Responses request-body capture was attached to the shared external HTTP sender and silently expanded to Qwen.
mechanical_prevention: The exact unknown-usage response case is now a selected CI regression.
Provider execution and export share measured_turn_usage.
External request-body persistence is explicit opt-in and jointly tests Qwen exclusion plus Responses retention.
retro.why: 为什么要有它：绿色 CI 应来自同一合同的生产与测试，而不是删除门禁或把未知值补成成功。

body:
## Parent

#3

## What to build

在干净的失败提交上复现 Continuous repository task and strategy contracts 的三类失败，区分过期测试合同与生产消费者缺陷，恢复可信的绿色集成基线。

为什么要有它：红色基线无法区分新功能退化和已有合同漂移，不能支撑批次准入、经验评测或交付结论。

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] 在干净工作区复现 semantic work state、delivery export 和 experience usage 三类失败。
- [ ] 每个失败都有当前权威合同依据，测试更新和生产修复不相互冒充。
- [ ] 三个受影响测试文件全部通过。
- [ ] CI 的 Continuous repository task and strategy contracts 完整选集通过。
- [ ] 原 workflow run、JUnit 和首次失败原件保留。
- [ ] 完成后执行 retro，并把可机械预防的合同漂移转为检查。
